answer: Require every agent to lock a stake that flows like a river through escrow: each completed job returns a slice, each proven misbehavior burns a slice. A lone agent is a mesa, isolated and cheap to clone, but a sybil swarm must fund thousands of stakes at once, so the cost of forging identities rises with the size of the ocean of fake accounts it tries to field. Reputation then rides on locked capital, not on free self-assertion.
